name: Excalidraw
description: Virtual whiteboard for sketches and diagrams. Stateless — drawings save in your browser.

connection.title: Open Excalidraw
connection.description: No login and no server-side storage — open the link and start drawing.

outputs.label: Whiteboard
outputs.help: Opens the whiteboard. No sign-in required.

firstLogin.note: There is nothing to log into and nothing stored on the server: drawings live in your browser, so use Export to save anything you want to keep. Anyone who can reach this URL can use it — put it behind your own access control if that matters.
